name: Howe Yuan
description_html:
THE HUMAN COIN TOSS On his day, he’s fucking Neuer. Pulls off saves that make you question the laws of physics, screams at defenders like he’s captaining Real Madrid, and somehow turns into a brick wall whenever the opposition gets within 20 yards. 10/10. Unplayable. Absolute monster.

Unfortunately, his “day” occurs approximately once every three months. The other 89 days, he’s a fucking liability. Near post? Free. Cross coming in? Hope for the best. Ball rolling slowly towards him? Genuinely 50/50. You never know which goalkeeper is turning up. Could be prime Buffon. Could be a bloke who has just discovered what gloves are. Rating: 10/10 if switched on. Rating: 1/10 if he woke up on the wrong side of the bed. Overall: 5/10 — statistically impossible to trust.

name: Fendy
description:
THE FUCKING BOUNCER

You don't beat this man. You negotiate with him.

Fierce, reliable, and built like someone accidentally left a refrigerator in the gym for 15 years. He doesn't defend space — he defends territory. If you have the ball, congratulations. You now have approximately three seconds to reconsider your life choices.

No fancy shit. No unnecessary nonsense. Just win the fucking ball, flatten the attack, and get everyone organised.

When the team starts falling apart, he's the one shouting, pointing, dragging everyone back into position and reminding the rest of us that apparently we're supposed to be playing football.

Tackles like he's collecting debts.

Heads crosses like they're personal insults.

And if someone thinks they're going to bully one of our smaller players, they get introduced to the fucking consequences.

The best part? You know exactly what you're getting every week.

No mood swings.
No disappearing acts.
No 'my hamstring feels a bit tight.'

Just 90 minutes of violence, organisation and absolutely zero fucking nonsense.

Rating: 9/10
Reliability: 11/10
Passing: We'll discuss that another day.
Leadership: Fucking enormous.
Opposition strikers: Strongly advised to seek alternative employment.
